sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72Bsizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18Ttokens.
